fact: Since 2021 the Ministry of Health has used Pendulum's AI forecasting for family planning commodities, delivered monthly to 52 facilities via mSupply Mobile with forecasts 38% more accurate than traditional methods, and a 2023 malaria proof of concept cut forecasting error by 37%.
title: Leveraging DHIS2 data to create AI-driven health facility forecasts in Cote d'Ivoire
publisher: DHIS2 Community (2024 DHIS2 Annual Conference abstract)
